answer.body: You have five working days after the grade is released to request a review of an assessment score by submitting a request in the LMS Support area. Your request should include the assessment name, the rubric criterion, and a short explanation of the issue.

Keep the timestamped submission receipt as proof of delivery. For assignments marked eligible for late submission, a learner may submit up to 48 hours after the deadline. The penalty is 10 percentage points per 24-hour period or part thereof. If the LMS is unavailable, contact course support and include the error details before the deadline where possible. A live session counts when the learner is present for at least half of its scheduled duration. Watching a recording does not count toward live attendance. A learner may request a documented accommodation from course support. Attendance records appear in the LMS Attendance area within two working days of a session.
